subject: StrataHealth renewal kickoff — commit path and QBR slot scouting
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Ari Gomez <ari@stratahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: StrataHealth renewal kickoff — commit path and QBR slot scouting

Hi Ari —

Congrats on closing out a very productive year with StrataHealth. Per our renewal playbook I wanted to kick off a short 2–3 week plan to lock down the commit path, surface any term changes you need, and schedule a QBR to align execs and ops.

Quick items I propose:
- Confirm current usage & expected 12-month throughput (you mentioned some new ingest pipelines).
- Identify any term changes (billing cadence, SLA bump, or data residency asks).
- Slot two possible QBR windows (we can do a short exec + ops hybrid).
- Determine who from your side will own procurement and legal.

I attached a one-page proposed timeline (2027-03-02_strata_proposed_timeline.xlsx) and the SOC 2 summary we often share during renewals.

Suggested QBR windows (PST):
- Week of Mar 22: Tue/Thu mornings (exec + technical 45/60 min)
- Week of Mar 29: Wed afternoon (preferred for ops leads)

Can you confirm who should be on the invite and whether you prefer annual prepay vs. staggered staircase commit? If you prefer, we can include a short Dedicated capacity demo showing how burst pools would affect unit economics.

Next steps on our side: Kimberley will scope legal asks and Marissa will prepare the uplift staffing plan. Karthik will run a quick capacity model.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Regards,
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
n: +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Ari Gomez <ari@stratahealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stratahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StrataHealth renewal kickoff — commit path and QBR slot scouting

Hi Nikhil —

Thanks — this looks good. Quick answers:
- I'll own the commercial side; looping in Procurement for legal & signatures (cc'd).
- We expect a 25% uptick in token throughput after the new ingest goes live (targeting April rollout).
- We are inclined to keep annual billing but would like to discuss an SLA uplift for latency sensitive routes.

QBR availability: Week of Mar 29 looks best for our ops and Eng leads. Please include a short demo of Dedicated burst behavior (20–30 min).

Attachments I can share: current throughput dashboard screenshot and a short security evidence packet — will send separately.

Thanks,
Ari
Head of Platform | StrataHealth
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ari Gomez <ari@stratahealth.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StrataHealth renewal kickoff — commit path and QBR slot scouting

Ari —

Appreciate the clarity. A few legal/contract items I want to call out before we lock terms:
- If you want an SLA uplift we will need to scope the routes covered and confirm incident response objectives (I can draft an amendment).
- If Procurement prefers DocuSign for signatures, please flag the counterparty name and the signee's job title.
- We usually require 30 days notice for data residency/on-prem options — flag that now if relevant.

Nikhil/Marissa: can you slot a 45-minute QBR + 20-minute Dedicated demo for Wed Mar 31 at 11:00am PT? If Ari confirms, I'll prepare a contract amendment draft and pre-fill the DocuSign envelope.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Ari Gomez <ari@stratahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@stratahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StrataHealth renewal kickoff — commit path and QBR slot scouting

Ari — confirmed for Wed, Mar 31 at 11:00am PT. Calendar invite incoming; agenda below:

Agenda (75 min total)
- 11:00–11:10: Roll call & renewal objectives (Nikhil)
- 11:10–11:30: Usage trend & 12‑month forecast (Ari + Strata ops)
- 11:30–11:50: Dedicated capacity demo + burst economics (Karthik)
- 11:50–12:05: Terms & SLA uplift discussion (Kimberly)
- 12:05–12:15: Procurement & signature next steps (Procurement)
- 12:15–12:15: Quick Q&A and action owner recap (Marissa)

Action owners: 
- Nikhil: send calendar + shared Drive folder (done)
- Karthik: prepare a 10-slide demo deck and cost delta table
- Marissa: staffing & onboarding timeline for additional seats/burst support
- Kimberly: draft amendment and DocuSign ready template

Ari/Procurement — can you confirm the signee (name & title) and whether annual prepay is acceptable (we'll show economics both ways)? If you can share the throughput screenshot Ari mentioned that will help Karthik model the uplift.

Attaching the timeline and SOC2 summary again for convenience.

Thanks everyone — see you on Mar 31.

—
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
